title: Boundary Programme: machine-checked boundary potential and level identification
description:
Lean 4 development tree for the Boundary Programme (research programme: The Mind Has a Boundary). The unified audit body comprises 56 files, 467 theorems/lemmas and 90 definitions, with 0 sorry and no custom axioms.

Contents: (A) the A-module boundary-potential evidence, including the machine-checked C_H = pi^2/3 chain; and (B) the formal spine for closure fixed points, level non-intrinsicality (weak form), identification, and the readout bound theta* = 2/(1+e). The Paper B canonical subset is 53 files / 417 theorems/lemmas / 77 definitions.

The accompanying papers are preprints and have not been peer reviewed. This deposit archives the source tree at tag v1.1.1; it is not a venue for the papers.
notes: Code is Apache-2.0; documentation and data are CC BY 4.0. Papers are preprints, not peer-reviewed. A separate genesis record anchors the standalone release package at the v1.1.0 commit with two independent timestamps (OpenTimestamps/Bitcoin and RFC 3161). That record covers the package bytes and the tree manifest, not this Zenodo archive: the two digest layers are independent and do not cross-certify each other.
